item.title: Mississippi baseball card collector cashes in on major find at Grenada GameStop

item.title: SuperTalk Eagle Hour 2/24/2026
item.description: Former Southern Miss pitcher and Eagle Hour baseball analyst Daniel Stewart and Jack Duggan, USM Associate Athletic Director for Communications, look at tonight’s game against Alabama at The Pete and this weekend’s series against Louisiana Tech in Ruston. Plus, the guys update on USM basketball.

item.title: Thunder & Lightning: Another Run Rule Win, Another Rumblings
item.description: Mississippi State baseball is starting to heat up, just in time for a massive weekend in Arlington with a looming showdown with #1 UCLA. The only thing hotter than the Bulldog bats are the takes flying from Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk, back with another outstanding edition of The Rumblings.
